::: {#sol-door-presses}

Follow the door one action at a time:

| action | | `o` | `l` | `c` | `l` | `o` | `u` | `o` |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| condition | closed | open | open | closed | locked | locked | closed | open |

The first `l` does nothing, because the door is open,
and the second `o` does nothing, because the door is locked.
At the end the door is open.

:::
